test_active_agent_completes_normally: test the FakeAgent class with an active agent that completes normally without triggering inactivity timeout
test_idle_agent_triggers_timeout: test the SlowFakeAgent class with an idle agent that triggers inactivity timeout after going idle
test_unlimited_timeout: test that HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT=0 means no timeout at all with unlimited agent runs
test_timeout_env_var_parsing: test that HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT environment variable value is correctly parsed as float
test_timeout_zero_means_unlimited: test that HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT=0 yields None for unlimited inactivity timeout
test_timeout_error_includes_diagnostics: test that timeout error message includes last activity summary diagnostics
test_agent_without_activity_summary_uses: test that agents without get_activity_summary use wallclock fallback and never time out
test_hermes_time_importable: test that cron.scheduler._hermes_now is importable from cron context
test_hermes_constants_importable: test that hermes_constants.get_hermes_home is importable from cron context
